backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a social media backend implementing posts, comments, likes, follows, messaging, notifications, friend requests, and user profiles with access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two media-rendering fix features (PostCard and ExplorePage) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing component purposes and notable fixes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining light and dark OKLCH CSS custom properties for the design token system (colors, borders, sidebar, charts).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with the page title set to 'Smileup' and a root div that mounts the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in ThemeProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and QueryClientProvider, showing a loading splash, LandingPage for unauthenticated users, or the full router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Avatar component that renders an ExternalBlob profile picture as an or falls back to gradient initials, supporting xs–xl sizes and both legacy and new prop naming conventions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six icon links (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile), hiding itself on the /shortsport route and showing a dot badge on Messages when conversations exist.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: An editor panel for managing audio tracks, supporting file upload and microphone recording, with per-track volume sliders, mute toggles, and removal controls.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: A React panel component for editing canvas design properties including aspect ratio, background color/gradient presets, shape overlays, and decorative elements. Allows users to apply solid colors or gradient presets to the first clip and toggle shape layers.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: A canvas-based rendering component that draws the current video frame, background color, text layers, sticker layers, vignette, glitch, and letterbox effects using the HTML5 Canvas API based on the current editor state.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: A timeline UI component that renders a ruler, playhead, and draggable clip tracks for video/image/blank clips, supporting scrubbing, clip removal, and adding new blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: A panel component for toggling visual motion graphics effects (confetti, glitch, letterbox, etc.) on the editor state, displaying active effects as tags and available effects as a grid of toggle buttons.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: A panel component for exporting and sharing a video clip, providing title/description metadata fields, a video preview, and a download button that creates a blob URL for the source file.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: A panel component for applying and fine-tuning video filter settings (brightness, contrast, saturation, vignette, etc.) via preset buttons and individual sliders, with a reset-to-defaults option.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: A React panel component for adding and managing emoji sticker layers on a video editor, supporting categorized emoji selection, sticker placement with random positioning, and controls for size, rotation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: A React panel component for adding and editing text layers in a video editor, with controls for font, size, color, bold/italic, alignment, animation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: A React panel component that displays a library of video transition effects and allows users to apply specific transitions between consecutive clips in the editor.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, main content outlet, and BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel showing user notifications (follows, messages) with read/unread state, timestamps, and navigation on click.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Displays a single post with media (image/video), author info, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, optimistic like updates, and intersection-observer-based view recording.
A dialog modal that shows a grid of the current user's posts as thumbnails, allowing selection of one to share in a message.
frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx: A dialog for sharing a post with selected friends via direct messages, with multi-select friend list and send confirmation.
frontend/src/components/StoriesRow.tsx: A horizontally scrollable stories row showing the current user's story button with a popup and mock story items that open a viewer modal on tap.
frontend/src/components/StoryViewerModal: A full-screen modal overlay that displays a single story with a progress bar, user avatar, timestamp, and story content, closing on Escape key or backdrop click.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A sticky top navigation bar showing the Smileup wordmark, notification bell with unread badge, search button, and sign-out button, with a dropdown notifications panel.
frontend/src/components/TrendingProfiles: A horizontally scrollable section displaying top creator cards with rank, avatar, follower count, and a profile navigation button, with loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, play button, duration badge, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, and a double-tap like animation.
frontend/src/components/YourStoryPopup.t: A small dropdown popup anchored below a trigger element offering two actions: viewing the user's own posts or creating a new post, closing on outside click.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook for ICP, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a collection of React Query hooks for interacting with the ICP backend actor, covering user profiles, posts, likes, comments, notifications, messaging, and friend requests.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Inter and Syne fonts, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using OKLCH color values, and adds utility classes for glassmorphism, gold gradients, and scrollbar hiding.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and mock data arrays for Posts, Comments, Users, Stories, Messages, and Conversations used as placeholder data throughout the frontend.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides utility functions: `cn` for merging Tailwind class names, `formatNumber` for K/M abbreviations, `formatTime` for mm:ss formatting, and `timeAgo` for relative timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, mounting it to the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating new posts supporting text, image, and video types, with file selection, media preview, upload progress tracking, and submission via the `useCreatePost` mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page that manages editor state (clips, text layers, stickers, audio, filters, effects) and renders a panel-based UI with tools for trimming, filters, effects, stickers, design, and export.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore/search page with debounced search input and tabs for browsing posts or searching users, fetching data via `useGetAllPosts` and `useSearchUsers` hooks and displaying results with navigation support.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the main social feed with stories, trending profiles, and a sorted list of posts; handles loading/error/empty states and opens a comments sheet on post interaction.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Unauthenticated landing page for Smileup that shows branding, a feature highlights grid, and an Internet Identity login button.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging UI with a conversation list sidebar and a message thread view; supports sending messages, marking them read, and starting new chats from friends/following lists.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper that reads a principalId route param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected as the initial conversation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows the authenticated user's profile with editable display name, handle, bio, and avatar, plus a grid of their posts and liked posts with a first-time setup flow.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical video feed that auto-plays the active video, supports mute/unmute, like, comment, share, follow/unfollow, and auto-scroll to the next video on end.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Displays a public user's profile page, fetching profile data by either principal ID or handle, and rendering their posts grid along with follow/friend action buttons.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines and registers all TanStack Router routes (feed, explore, profile, messages, etc.) and exports the configured router instance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, typography/container-query plugins, custom fonts, border radii, and box shadows.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state for the Smileup social media app, listing existing features, known issues (media not rendering), and pending fix requests for ProfilePage, UserProfilePage, ShortSportPage, and blob rendering.
